gui.reason: EXPERIMENTAL / UNWITNESSED. Runtime off in every preset; its three locks default on. Protected UI integration is in WIRING.md.

input_constraints: Pinned USA XBE and the complete sealed owner union. Rebuild v1 or different configurations from the supported base.
Three independent Boolean locks default true when the runtime is enabled; abilities stays off in every preset.
Two footer bits encode Unranked/Star/Superstar/X-Factor. Slot limits 0/2/4/7; legacy Unranked flags retain v1 permissions. Excess flags on a tiered record fail closed.
Juke/Agility, Stiff-Arm/Strength, Hurdle/Jumping, Truck/Break Tackle and Spin/Pass Rush gain at most 0.02 per tier after native clamps, capped at 1 during live phase 14.
With either move lock on, charge is limited to live carriers and known move consumers. Both move locks off restores native charge. Disabled locks never grant rating bonuses.
Off-week None or integer 0..17, exact franchise regular-season tuple. No simulated-game effect or save migration.
portme: Apply WIRING.md, regenerate the production manifest and complete Noah's witness list in ASTRA_ABILITIES_V2_REPORT.md.

public_distribution.rule: Ship source and recipes; never distribute the generated game executable or disc.

runtime.scope: Bounded native getters, both clamps, permissions, charge and shared Momentum reads. No loader, save lifecycle, gameplay or outcome witness.
